purpose: Freeze the exact bridge from an input-relative invariant polynomial representation envelope to a polynomial total SAT decision runtime, while keeping the universal preservation premise explicitly open.

definitions.N: encoded length of the original CNF input phi
definitions.A: one fixed deterministic JANUS theorem-mode algorithm frozen before the input is seen
definitions.S_i: the i-th reachable representation state produced by A on phi
definitions.B_N: N^c for one fixed universal integer c
definitions.E_N_S: encoded state and every retained representation resource are <= B_N and the state belongs to the admitted tractable representation language

premises.statement: For every CNF phi of encoded length N, the canonical initial state S_0 satisfies E_N(S_0).

For every state S_i reachable under A, if E_N(S_i) holds and S_i is nonterminal, the unique frozen scheduled transition followed by normalization terminates and returns S_(i+1) satisfying E_N(S_(i+1)).
Every scheduled transition is decision preserving with the required contextual semantics; conservative extensions carry explicit projection semantics where used.

There exists one fixed b such that transition discovery/recognition, execution, normalization, certificate production and independent verification at each reachable step use at most N^b bit operations.
There exists one fixed a such that A performs at most N^a scheduled macrosteps.
The terminal state has an exact truth query computable in polynomial time in N.

The envelope/work ledgers include clauses, factors, DAG nodes and edges, contexts/boundary states, semantic auxiliary variables, integer/coefficient bit lengths, proof/certificate bytes, normalization microsteps, indexes and failed deterministic discovery work.

lemma.name: POLYNOMIAL_ENVELOPE_INDUCTION_LEMMA
lemma.statement: P1 and P2 imply E_N(S_i) for every reachable step by induction. P4 and P5 bound the sum of all nonterminal work by N^(a+b) up to fixed polynomial overhead; P6 adds only polynomial terminal work. P3 transfers terminal truth back to the original CNF decision. Therefore A decides SAT in polynomial time if P1-P7 hold universally.
proof: Induction: assume E_N(S_i); if nonterminal, P2 returns S_(i+1) and preserves E_N.
Hence the representation never leaves the fixed input-relative envelope before termination.
There are at most N^a macrosteps by P5, each costing at most N^b bit operations by P4, so scheduled work is at most N^(a+b).
Terminal work is polynomial by P6.
Exact decision preservation from P3 makes the returned terminal truth equal to SAT(phi).

relation_to_existing_frontier.SRR_ENFC: P2 is the size/tractability-preservation core of the schedule-relative reachable closure target.
relation_to_existing_frontier.PIRC: E_N defines the polynomial invariant representation corridor in an input-relative form.
relation_to_existing_frontier.M2R: M2R may forecast the first likely P2/P4/P7 failure but has no proof authority.
relation_to_existing_frontier.TOPA: TOPA attacks P1-P7 and searches for a first exact counterexample/failure witness.
relation_to_existing_frontier.Fundamentum: Only exact proofs/certificates may discharge P1-P7 for theorem promotion.

next_theorem_target: Prove or refute P2 on the typed reachable corridor using exact family recognition, residual-interface quotient accounting and hostile fixed-language/boundary-width controls.
